overview_description.description: Nomic is a bioengineering company working to make the human proteome as broadly and easily accessible as the human genome. They are building the nELISA, a next-generation protein profiling platform for measuring proteins at scale and at high throughput. They offer scientists protein profiling solutions and empower them to decide the scope and scale of their experiments.

about_short_description.short_description: Nomic develops a proteomic technology platform to understand, detect, and treat diseases with DNA nanotechnology.

product.name: nELISA
product.description: A multiplexed immunoassay platform that enables high-throughput, quantitative protein profiling with minimized cross-reactivity.

product.name: Omni 1000
product.description: A proteomic panel profiling 1000 informative proteins with absolute quantification for broad biological and disease insights.

product.name: Core Immune Panel
product.description: A targeted proteomic panel covering key immune pathways and inflammatory markers for immune-related research.

product.name: Core CardioMet Panel
product.description: A targeted proteomic panel providing deep coverage of cardiac and metabolic biology for cardiometabolic research.

product.name: Flex Custom Protein Profiling Panels
product.description: A customizable protein profiling service allowing selection of any targets from Nomic's library to build tailored panels.

product.name: Nomic Protein Profiling Service
product.description: An industrial-scale, mail-in protein profiling service based on nELISA technology with end-to-end expert support.
